title: 40,000 Bonus Velocity Points on Holiday Booking With Hopper Over $1000 @ Virgin Australia
body:
Deal: 40,000 Bonus Velocity Points on Holiday Booking With Hopper Over $1000 @ Virgin Australia

[Booshbosch] Damn so bookings need to be completed, so there’s no just book refundable hotel booking in October 2027… ?
[donkcat] Amex also have an offer on Virgin holidays Spend $1500 or more and get $300 back
[crazyhor77] only certain amex cards? i dont see the offer in my app :'(
[DingoBlue] So that's $400 worth of points (right?) plus Amex $300 cashback
[gembel] Looks like it has to be holidays. Hotel plus return flights combo. Doesn't sound like a good deal?
[Trance N Dance] For some it's considered buying points at as low as 2.3c/point with free flights, holiday and SCs attached.
[Brick50] Flight + holiday combined, so not the deal people think based on the title.
[Ventak] Pity Virgin doesn't have Auckland flights anymore…
[keji] Any good suggestions for a solo - thinking New Zealand or Vanuatu
[Cannu] Am I reading right that it’s per $1000+ trip?
Running some numbers:
MEL-BNE-CNS Return (CNS-BNE-MEL) in Business + 1 night stay @ ~$1,000 gets you:
- (60 + 60 + 60) x2 = 240 SC (Holidays uses SC by mileage)
- ~43,000 velocity points (40,000 + 3x$ spend)
And you could do this twice for double and then you’d hit the $1,500 spend get $300 back from AMEX offer
So 480 SC + ~85,000 Velocity points for ~$1,700. Seems like a pretty great deal for someone wanting to boost their status and point bank
[ryefig] VA holiday bookings. Not standalone flight bookings.
[Cannu] That’s correct, hence the +1 night stay. Hardest part would be getting this route with accom for as little as ~$1,000
[lachhelix] Where do you see that VA Holidays still uses SC by mileage?
Nvm: found it in T&C!
[ryefig] Got ya. Can you let me know how you got it to do an indirect flight?
